sn35.82:1.1: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn35.82:2.1: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘the world, the world.’
sn35.82:2.2: In what way, venerable sir, is it said ‘the world’?”
sn35.82:2.3: “It is disintegrating, bhikkhu, therefore it is called the world.
sn35.82:2.6: forms are disintegrating, eye-consciousness is disintegrating, eye-contact is disintegrating, and whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition … that too is disintegrating.
sn35.82:2.8: The mind is disintegrating … Whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition … that too is disintegrating.
sn35.82:2.9: It is disintegrating, bhikkhu, therefore it is called the world.”
